reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 mentions Cu addition for toughness and wear resistance but does not study tribofilm formation or high-temperature sliding. E2 discusses grain size effects on wear in a different HEA (CoCrFeMnNi) without Cu, and does not address copper-rich oxide tribofilms. The core claims about Cu-induced oxide tribofilm stability and friction reduction across the full temperature range lack specific prior evidence.
premises: Cu addition to CoCrFeNi promotes formation of a copper-rich oxide tribofilm
The copper-rich oxide tribofilm is stable and protective from RT to 800 °C
The oxide tribofilm reduces direct asperity contact, lowering friction and wear
Cu addition enhances toughness and wear resistance in CoCrFeNi-based HEAs
Fine grain size improves wear resistance in CoCrFeMnNi HEA
